description: The posts of a profile, a page per call: public posts (videos, reels, shorts, photos, carousels, tweets and text) with their author, text, media, and views, likes and comments. Pass handle: a profile link, @handle, username or ID. Price per successful page: Bluesky, Facebook, Instagram, Kwai, Reddit, Rumble, Threads, TikTok, Truth Social, X, YouTube: 1 credit. LinkedIn: 1 credit (public page) or 10 credits (data partner). Follow next_cursor while it is set; a short page is not the end.

cursor.description: next_cursor from this tool's previous result: the next page, or the rest of a cut result. Send the same other arguments.

detail.description: concise (default) returns the fields that answer most questions, without platform_type, link_url, language, coauthors, thumbnail_url, media, mentions, is_sponsored, is_nsfw and platform_specific; full returns every field. Same price: ask for full in the first call when you need one of them.

duration.description: Only on Rumble. Only short videos (Rumble's Under 4 minutes) or long ones (Over 20 minutes).

handle.description: A profile link, @handle, username or ID.

limit.description: Items per page, up to the endpoint's page size (the default; larger values are reduced to it). Omit it for the cheapest walk: a page costs the same whatever its limit.

max_age.description: Accept a cached answer up to this many seconds old; cache hits are free. Omit to always fetch live.

max_credits.description: The most this request may be charged, in credits. One that would cost more stops first, free, with insufficient_credits (details.reason max_credits). Omit for the endpoint's price, up to its maximum.

media.description: Only on LinkedIn or X. LinkedIn: Only posts of one kind. X: Only the account's own posts, no reposts, with media: any (a photo, video or GIF), image (photos) or video (a video or GIF).

platform.description: Optional with a profile link, which names it; needed with a bare username or ID.

since.description: Only items at or after this time: RFC 3339 (2026-10-01T12:00:00Z) or a date (2026-10-01, midnight UTC).

sort.description: Only on Reddit, Rumble, X or YouTube. Order of the results.

tab.description: Only on Bluesky, Rumble or YouTube. Bluesky: The profile tab to list. Rumble: The tab to list. YouTube: The channel tab to list.

until.description: Only items before this time (exclusive): RFC 3339 or a date (midnight UTC).

name: list_posts
title: Posts of a profile
